topic: API project deployment plan and scope
summary_markdown:
The API project faced delays due to necessary refactoring, requiring the integration of a data-api into the main analytics project to prevent code duplication. The final stage is nearing completion.

[me] plans to deploy a version to staging tomorrow (pending assistance from someone).
[p1] suggested deploying an initial version without demographic data to simplify the rollout.
decisions: The API project will be deployed to staging tomorrow.
The initial deployment scope will exclude demographic data.
action_items: Someone needs to ensure the staging environment is ready for deployment.
